title: Measurement of Centromeric Array Size Changes Using ddPCR
author: Showman, Talbert, et al.

Timing: 30 min. Time depends on the number of samples
6.Thaw frozen sub-clone cell pellets, parent cells, and ddPCR positive control that are stored at −20°C.7.Resuspend pellets in 200 μL of 1X PBS.8.Using the QIAGEN blood and tissue kit, add 20 μL of proteinase K.9.Add 200 μL Buffer AL and mix thoroughly by vortexing.10.Add 200 μL of ice-cold 100% ethanol and mix thoroughly.11.Place the mixture into a DNeasy mini spin column and centrifuge at >6,000 × g for 1 min.12.Discard the flowthrough.13.Add 500 μL Buffer AW1 and centrifuge at >6,000 × g for 1 min.14.Discard the flowthrough.15.Add 500 μL Buffer AW2 and centrifuge at >20,000 × g for 1 min.16.Discard the flowthrough.17.Centrifuge at >20,000 × g for 3 min.18.Discard the flowthrough.19.Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.20.Add 200 μL of Buffer AE to the center of the column and incubate at room temperature for 1 min.21.Insert columns into tubes and centrifuge at >6,000 × g for 1 min.22.Discard the column and collect the gDNA.
Note: We tested a direct PCR lysis reagent and NucleoSpin tissue XS assay to reduce the number of cells needed, but the results using these assays were not as consistent as the results from the QIAGEN blood and tissue kit.
Pause point: gDNA can be stored at −20°C.

steps.title: Culture U2OS and collect conditioned media
steps.instruction: Thaw an early‑passage U2OS stock, passage at least twice, then seed 1.5 × 10⁶ cells in a T‑75 flask with 15 mL media. Incubate at 37 °C for 2–3 days until ~80 % confluent. Remove the conditioned media into a 50 mL conical tube, wash the flask once with 1X PBS, trypsinize in 3 mL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA for 5 min at 37 °C, add 7 mL fresh media and pipette to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Isolate single cells via limiting dilution
steps.instruction: Measure cell concentration with a Vi‑cell analyzer, resuspend to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in a 1.5 mL tube, then dilute to 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL and re‑measure. Prepare 1:10 (10 000 cells/mL) and 1:100 (1 000 cells/mL) dilutions in 1.5 mL tubes containing media. Filter the conditioned media through a 0.22 µm PES filter. Add 50 µL of the 1:100 dilution to 10.5 mL filtered media, mix, and dispense 100 µL into each well of a 96‑well plate except well H12. Add 100 µL of the 1:10 dilution to well H12. Keep the plate undisturbed in a 37 °C incubator for 7 days.

substeps.instruction: Measure cell number with Vi‑cell analyzer.
Resuspend to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in 1.5 mL tube.
Dilute to 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL, re‑measure.
Create 1:10 (10 000 cells/mL) and 1:100 (1 000 cells/mL) dilutions in media‑containing tubes.
Filter conditioned media through 0.22 µm PES filter.
Add 50 µL of 1:100 dilution to 10.5 mL filtered media, mix.
Dispense 100 µL of this suspension into each well except H12.
Add 100 µL of 1:10 dilution to well H12.
Incubate plate undisturbed at 37 °C for 7 days.

steps.title: Identify monoclonal wells by microscopy
steps.instruction: On day 7, focus the microscope using cells in well H12, scan the entire 96‑well plate, and mark wells that contain a single colony. Monitor the marked wells daily and discard any well that shows more than one colony or an abnormal growth rate.

substeps.instruction: Focus microscope on well H12.
Scan all wells and record those with a single colony.
Check marked wells each day; discard wells with >1 colony or divergent growth.

steps.title: Expand monoclonal colonies
steps.instruction: Wash monoclonal wells twice with 1X PBS, then trypsinize each colony in 100 µL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA for 5 min at 37 °C. Add 100 µL fresh media and pipette to obtain a single‑cell suspension. Transfer 200 µL of this suspension to a well of a 12‑well plate and add 800 µL fresh media to each well.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells containing monoclonal colonies twice with 1X PBS.
Trypsinize in 100 µL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA, 5 min at 37 °C.
Add 100 µL media and pipette to disperse cells.
Transfer 200 µL to a 12‑well plate well.
Add 800 µL media to each 12‑well.

steps.title: Harvest confluent monoclonal colonies
steps.instruction: When colonies in the 12‑well plate reach confluence, wash once with 1X PBS, trypsinize in 500 µL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA for 5 min at 37 °C, add 500 µL media (≥ trypsin volume) and pipette to obtain a single‑cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Wash confluent colonies once with 1X PBS.
Trypsinize in 500 µL 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA, 5 min at 37 °C.
Add 500 µL media (at least equal to trypsin volume) and pipette to disperse cells.

steps.title: Prepare HOR copy‑number control
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the remaining parent cells at 300 × g for 5 min, discard the supernatant, and store the cell pellet at –20 °C until needed for ddPCR.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge parent cells 300 × g, 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Store pellet at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare CHM13 positive control
steps.instruction: Thaw a CHM13 cryostock containing 2 × 10⁶ cells, expand to 1 × 10⁷ cells, aliquot 1 × 10⁶ cells into each 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and store the pellet at –20 °C until ddPCR.

substeps.instruction: Thaw CHM13 stock (2 × 10⁶ cells) and expand to 1 × 10⁷ cells.
Aliquot 1 × 10⁶ cells into each 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge 200 × g, 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Store pellet at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 20X primer working stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20X primer‑pair working stock for the targeted HOR and reference single‑gene primers as described in the Materials and equipment section, then store the stock at –20 °C.

steps.title: Isolate subclones from monoclonal line
steps.instruction: Place frozen sub‑clone cell pellets (or monoclonal frozen stock) into 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and store the pellets at –20 °C until ddPCR.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge 300 × g, 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Store pellet at –20 °C.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cell pellets, resuspend each in 200 µL 1X PBS, add 20 µL proteinase K (QIAGEN kit), 200 µL Buffer AL, vortex, then add 200 µL ice‑cold 100 % ethanol and mix. Load the mixture onto a DNeasy mini spin column and centrifuge >6 000 × g for 1 min; discard flow‑through. Wash with 500 µL Buffer AW1 (centrifuge >6 000 × g, 1 min) and 500 µL Buffer AW2 (centrifuge >20 000 × g, 1 min). Perform a final spin >20 000 × g for 3 min, discard flow‑through, transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 200 µL Buffer AE, incubate at room temperature 1 min, centrifuge >6 000 × g for 1 min, discard the column and collect the eluate as gDNA. Store gDNA at –20 °C if not used immediately.

substeps.instruction: Thaw frozen cell pellets.
Resuspend in 200 µL 1X PBS.
Add 20 µL proteinase K (QIAGEN kit).
Add 200 µL Buffer AL; vortex thoroughly.
Add 200 µL ice‑cold 100 % ethanol; mix.
Load onto DNeasy mini spin column; centrifuge >6 000 × g, 1 min; discard flow‑through.
Add 500 µL Buffer AW1; centrifuge >6 000 × g, 1 min; discard flow‑through.
Add 500 µL Buffer AW2; centrifuge >20 000 × g, 1 min; discard flow‑through.
Centrifuge >20 000 × g, 3 min; discard flow‑through.
Transfer column to new 1.5 mL tube.
Add 200 µL Buffer AE to column center; incubate RT 1 min.
Centrifuge >6 000 × g, 1 min; collect eluate (gDNA).
Store gDNA at –20 °C (pause point).

steps.title: Analyze ddPCR data
steps.instruction: After droplet reading, open Quantasoft, select the run, and verify the NTC well is contamination‑free. For each experimental well targeting a HOR, open the 1‑D amplitude plot, manually place a horizontal gate to separate positive from negative droplets; repeat for the reference single‑gene (SG) wells. Export the results.csv file. Exclude any well with <10 000 accepted droplets, a markedly different average amplitude, <100 positive droplets, or <10 negative droplets. Multiply each HOR copy number by 20 to correct for the 1:20 gDNA input dilution. Normalize HOR copy number to the SG copy number by dividing the HOR value by the paired SG value for each technical replicate; repeat for all replicates. Perform an ANOVA followed by Tukey’s HSD test in R to compare each subclone’s copy number to the parental value.

substeps.instruction: Open Quantasoft and select the completed ddPCR run.
Check the NTC well for contamination.
For each HOR‑targeting well, view the 1‑D amplitude plot and place a horizontal gate separating positive and negative droplets.
Repeat gating for each SG‑targeting well.
Export results.csv.
Filter out wells with: <10 000 accepted droplets; distinct average amplitude; <100 positive droplets; <10 negative droplets.
Multiply HOR copy number by 20 (dilution factor).
Normalize HOR copy number by dividing by the paired SG copy number for each replicate.
Repeat normalization for all technical replicates.
Run ANOVA and Tukey’s HSD in R to compare subclone CNs to parental CN.
